name: SDEF Shiksha Shakti Scholarship 2026-27 (girls, non-technical UG)

rules.quote: Male applicants, since this scholarship is for female students only.

rules.value: first year full-time non-technical UG in India, 2026-27
rules.quote: Enroll as a first-year, full-time undergraduate student in a non-technical programme in India for 2026–27.
Have secured a minimum of 80% marks or equivalent CGPA in Class XII.
Have an annual family income of ₹12,00,000 or less from all sources.

rules.value: no drop/gap year after class XII; no part-time
rules.quote: Drop/ Gap Year after Class XII is not eligible.

rules.value: preference to first-generation students and government/government-aided school alumni
rules.quote: Preference may be given to applicants who studied in Government or Government-aided schools.

amount.text: Up to Rs 20,000 per academic year, up to Rs 1,00,000 over five years; 150-200 scholarships a year
amount.quote: Annual Award: Up to ₹20,000 per academic year

documents.name: Photograph, Aadhaar, Class X and XII marksheets
Admission letter, college ID, fee receipt
Family income proof, utility bill, three residence photographs
documents.quote: Utility Bill — Electricity, Water or Gas
